messages.subject: clickable charts
parts:
Hello,

I would like to display a scatter plot and allow the user to click on the chart.

I don't care where vertically, I would like to capture where they are horizontally.

Is this possible with any of the Shiny technology?


Thanks.


Stephen

messages.author: 74509c5715c23e0d
messages.subject: Re: clickable charts
parts:
hi Stephen,

I made a demo of a clickable plot for BioC2014 conference, you can adapt the code here: https://github.com/mikelove/shinyMA

This involved writing a function findClosest(), which takes the x,y input from a click event on the plot, (log transforms and) scales it based on the range of the xlim and ylim, and then finds the closest observation in the dataset. 

This function could be generalized and added to shiny?

Lots of room for improvement: the log transform could be automatically detected from the plot. also the xlim and ylim should be grabbed somehow using par("usr"), because xlim != range(x)

best,

Mike
